newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Industries sold to Indonesian grp.
newsitem.headline: Allied Industries sold to Indonesian grp.

text.p: Allied Group Limited and Allied Properties (H.K) Limited have sold their holdings in Allied Industries International Ltd to an Indonesian-based investment group with extensive manufacturing in China, the companies said in statements on Monday.

Allied Group and Allied Properties sold their combined 50.59 percent stake, or 410.36 million shares, in Allied Industries to Wiseway Enterprises Ltd, a British Virgin Islands registered company 60 percent owned by Suryadi Tanuwidjaja and Subandi Tanuwidjaja of Indonesia.
The shares were sold at HK$0.85 per share for a total consideration of HK$348.81 million.

The sale price represents a discount of 14.14 percent to the closing price of HK$0.99 per Allied Industries share on December 17 and a discount of 2.30 percent to the audited net asset value of the company of HK$0.87 as at December 31, 1995.
The share sale agreement, wherein Wiseway acquires 50.59 percent of Allied Industries, requires that Wiseway make an unconditional cash offer for the rest of the company.
Wiseway has said it is offering HK$0.85 for each share and HK$0.01 for every 100 options.
As at December 21, there were outstanding options for the subscription of 43.91 million shares, exercisable at HK$1.00 per share. The options are valued at HK$4,391.
Wiseway said it intends to maintain Allied Industries' listing.

Trading in shares of Allied Group, Allied Properties and Allied Industries, which was suspended on Thursday and Friday, was resumed on Monday. In mid-morning trade, Allied Group was up HK$0.01 at HK$0.84, Allied Properties put on HK$0.04 to HK$1.24 and Allied Industries gained HK$0.08 to HK$1.07.
